producer_script: Script do Record Producer, de mapeamento. Lê o registro de x_nasm_hr_profile indicado pela variável 'employee' e grava o campo 'user' desse perfil em current.requested_for, definindo o solicitante do caso. Grava também current.item com o sysparm_id vindo da URL, que é o sys_id do próprio record producer — é esse campo que as triggers de flow usam para identificar de qual item o registro veio.

variaveis.name: v_redemptions_taxed_at_15_at_source_for_any_amount
variaveis.label: Redemptions taxed at 15% at source for any amount, as an advance tax due on the Annual Adjustment Statement. Benefits will be taxed according to the progressive table. You will be able to opt for the Regressive Regime until the last business day of the next month through an Option Term. After this period, your permanence in the Progressive Regime will be definitive.
